evidence_basis: locally authored deterministic synthetic tests; no external validation

claims.claim: The Python provenance gate passed 42 local tests.
claims.falsifier: Run the indicated unittest command in a clean compatible environment and reproduce a failing case.

claims.claim: Of 16 authored scenarios, naive signature counting confirmed 8; provenance gate confirmed 4, reviewed 11, and flagged one conflict.
claims.falsifier: Run run_scenarios.py and obtain different decisions or totals.

claims.claim: A conventional equal-controls decision function matched every one of the 16 provenance-gate decisions.
claims.falsifier: Find a scenario in the recorded corpus where decisions differ.

claims.claim: A seeded 1,000-case synthetic order/mutation comparison produced zero baseline disagreements, no reversed-order result changes and no mismatched-action or single-root confirmations.
claims.falsifier: Run metamorphic_probe.py with seed 1956 and reproduce a nonzero anomaly count.

claims.claim: Two signed witnesses sharing a declared original root do not meet a 2-disjoint-source policy.
claims.falsifier: Construct a verified claim pair rooted in the same source that nevertheless passes the declared disjoint-root policy.

claims.claim: Two genuinely distinct declared roots can affirm a deliberately false fixture claim, and misregistered roots can fool the provenance gate.
claims.falsifier: Demonstrate the current code rejects those exact fixtures when evaluated without changing their declared metadata.

claims.claim: With externally audited source topology, a provenance gate can catch meaningful common-source duplication at acceptable false-review cost.
claims.falsifier: Preregister and run third-party-designed evidence cases; fail if no benefit over matched conventional comparator or false-review cost exceeds a declared threshold.
